rec.name: PDP Size Slider (Fit Scale)
rec.status: Built — delivered, preview link provided (product image for documentation was requested afterwards)

what.text: A fit-information box for the product page. It shows a horizontal scale with three labels ("Runs small" / "True to size" / "Runs large") and a filled circle that marks where this product's fit falls. A headline sits above the scale (the screenshot shows "Size Information" with the last word in bold). The box has an optional border and rounded corners. The position and labels are stored per product in a metaobject referenced by a product metafield. If no data is stored for a product, the block does not render. The ticket calls it a "section", but the delivered code is a theme block (type cro_pdp_size_slider, limit 1) inside the main-product section.

why.text: Uncertainty about sizing is a major barrier to buying apparel and accessories online, and a major cause of returns. A quick visual that shows whether an item runs small or large answers the "will it fit?" question right where the size is chosen. This reduces perceived risk and hesitation, and it can also cut size-related returns. A visual scale takes less effort to read than a text note, and the same pattern works across the whole catalog.

how.text: 1) In main-product.liquid, add a new block schema entry "CRO | Size Slider" (type cro_pdp_size_slider, limit 1) with the settings listed below. 2) In product-form.liquid, add a `when 'cro_pdp_size_slider'` case that renders the snippet 'ed-cro-pdp-size-slider' with product and block. 3) Create the snippet ed-cro-pdp-size-slider.liquid. It reads product.metafields.standard.cro_size_slider.value and outputs a heading, a scale bar span, and a list of labels. The indicator is a 16px filled circle drawn with a ::before pseudo-element, positioned with left: scale_position%. 4) In Shopify admin, create the metaobject definition "CRO | PDP | Size Slider" (type cro_pdp_size_slider) with fields name (required, display name), heading (single line text), labels (list of single line text, required) and scale_position (integer 0–100, required). 5) Create the product metafield "CRO | Size Slider" (standard.cro_size_slider, mixed reference to that metaobject). 6) Fill in the metaobject entries per product (or via an app/import) and assign them to the products. 7) Add the block to the product template in the theme editor, below the variant picker (as in the screenshot).

items: Scale size / bar thickness (1–8 px, step 0.5, default 4)
Per product (metaobject): heading text, list of three labels, scale position 0–100 %

dependencies.text: Needs a Shopify theme with a main-product section and product-form.liquid (it uses a block-based product template). Needs a metaobject definition (cro_pdp_size_slider) and a product metafield (standard.cro_size_slider, mixed reference), with values filled in per product. The snippet relies on a theme `visually-hidden` utility class. No app is required. The data can optionally be filled by an app or bulk import. The ticket also mentions that the value could come from a product rating, but the delivered code only supports the metafield/metaobject route.

items: PDP conversion rate (especially for products with the slider vs. without)
